column1: # vdi-all.tsv -- every VDI case in one table, for a single run.
# Rounds 1, 2 and 3 concatenated verbatim, in that order, so one pass on a
# machine measures everything instead of three passes with three tables.
# WHAT THIS COSTS, and it is not free: a case id is the PHYSICAL LINE NUMBER
# and the file CRC binds every dump to the file it was taken with. Every case
# here therefore has a DIFFERENT id from the same case in vdi-r1/r2/r3.tsv,
# and the dumps already taken with those tables cannot be compared against
# this one. They stay valid against their own tables; this table needs its
# own measurement on every machine.
# The round tables stay in the tree unchanged. Nothing already measured is
# invalidated -- it simply does not answer to this file.
# Overlap between the rounds is kept rather than deduplicated: round 1 and
# round 2 cover some of the same opcodes with different values, and deciding
# which variant to drop would be a judgement call with nothing to gain. A
# case measured twice costs a few milliseconds.
# Appending only, as always.
# opcode\tsub\tintin\tptsin\tcomment
# round 1 (cases/vdi-r1.tsv)
# --- inquiries: report state, change nothing ------------------------

column5: vql_attributes line attributes after the reset
vqm_attributes marker attributes after the reset
vqf_attributes fill attributes after the reset
vqt_attributes text attributes after the reset

vswr_mode out of range, echoes the default instead
